localChanges: The game menu has a Military Report, also on F2, as in Civ1: each type of unit you have or are building, with its attack, defence, movement and visibility, how many are active and how many your cities are building (#405).
The report also lists the units you've lost, by type: those another civilisation destroyed, and those lost at sea. They are counted from this release on, and kept in your saved games (closes #405).
